links.outcome: LLM output changes when non-decisive socio-demographic factors are added to inputs; EquityGuard detection and mitigation
links.effect: Adding non-decisive socio-demographic factors (race, sex, income, LGBT+ status, homelessness, illiteracy, disability, unemployment) led to incorrect and harmful outputs. EquityGuard was reported effective in promoting equitable outcomes; no numbers given in the abstract.
links.quote: However, our study shows that incorporating non-decisive socio-demographic factors, such as race, sex, income level, LGBT+ status, homelessness, illiteracy, disability, and unemployment, into the input of LLMs can lead to incorrect and harmful outputs.

screen.reason: Evaluates EquityGuard, a guardrail/safeguard framework designed to detect and mitigate bias/health inequity risks in medical LLM applications when socio-demographic factors are present in inputs.

primary.practice: guardrail framework for mitigating socio-demographic bias/equity risks
